summary: Lower += through a reference-aware helper so the LHS is evaluated once and JavaScript operator coercions are preserved.

target.notes: Evaluate the LHS reference once, GetValue once, evaluate RHS once, apply the underlying operation with JsOperators.Add, SetValue once, and return the assigned result.

caveats: Do not expand compound assignment into a source-level duplicated LHS.
Getters, setters, proxies, computed keys, and coercion hooks are observable.
The helper/compiler intrinsic must preserve numeric-kind errors such as Number/BigInt mixing.

tests.name: edge addition-assignment semantics
tests.input: let k=0; const o={x:1}; o[['x'][k++]] += 2; console.log(k,o.x);
tests.expected_behavior: prints 1 3; computed key is evaluated once
